title: Vect Nokru
subtitle: Independent
description: Vect Nokru led a group of mercenaries in Alderaan to abduct young Princess Leia. They escaped with the young girl to Daiyu, where Obi-Wan Kenobi hunted him down and took the precocious princess from his grasp. Nokru ultimately met his end when The Grand Inquisitor took his life.
